newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DUTCH JUNE MANUFACTURING SALES RISE 13 PCT YR/YR.
newsitem.headline: DUTCH JUNE MANUFACTURING SALES RISE 13 PCT YR/YR.

text.p: manufacturing sales were a provisional 13 percent higher than in
the same month of 1996, the Central Bureau of Statistics said.
The CBS manufacturing sales figures refer to the guilder
value of manufacturers' sales and are usually published one to
two weeks before manufacturing production figures which show the
rise or fall in volume terms.
CBS said the provisional manufacturing sales figure for June
was affected by the fact that June 1997 had one working day more
than in 1996. The impact is estimated at some 5 pct, it added.
